g.text: How do people spend their time?

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: Averages of hours and minutes per day from time-use diaries for people between 15 and 64.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: Note: Each country's most recent time-use survey is shown, with its year in brackets; survey years range from 1999 to 2024. Estimates cover people aged

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: 15 to 64, except in Australia (15 and over), China (15 to 74), Lithuania (20 to 64). Personal care covers sleep, eating and other personal care; unpaid work

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #858585

g.text: & other covers housework, shopping, care work, volunteering and civic activities; leisure covers TV and radio, seeing friends and other leisure.
